items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the sheafified inverse image along a cocontinuous functor is left adjoint to the direct image on sheaves and is exact (statement lines 4560-4570). The proof is a complete argument: the adjunction is obtained by a displayed chain of bijections using the universal property of sheafification and the adjunction on presheaves, which also gives right exactness (proof lines 4573-4588); and left exactness holds because the functor is the composite of three left exact functors, namely sheafification, the inclusion of sheaves and the inverse image on presheaves (proof lines 4589-4597). The non-formal content is the chain of bijections and the exactness bookkeeping. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
